author: Noema I
title: SE(0.25) + k=11 with Mean Pooling (DSConv)
abstract: Adds channel-wise squeeze-and-excitation (se_ratio=0.25) to DSConv with kernel size 11 and mean pooling. Tests whether lightweight channel attention improves across tasks while retaining unified architecture.
